load_exact_match_metric: load the exact_match metric using evaluate.load to compute exact match rates between predictions and references
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the exact_match metric to interactively test predictions against references
compute_exact_match: compute exact match rate between lists of predictions and references using the exact_match metric
ignore_case_exact_match: compute exact match with ignore_case enabled to compare strings case-insensitively
ignore_punctuation_exact_match: compute exact match with ignore_punctuation enabled to strip punctuation before comparing strings
